brief.aim: Model overall survival of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients from tumour gene expression in TCGA. Derive a risk stratification on TCGA only, then validate it once on the external CPTAC cohort with Kaplan-Meier curves and a log-rank test.
brief.repeated_subjects: One expression profile per PatientID; no repeated measures per subject in this table.
brief.unit: one tumour sample from one HNSCC patient in the TCGA cohort
